close_reason: Strengthened the comment block on the up-front non-string-element rejection at task.rs:335-342, task_list.rs:222-229, task_notification.rs:117-124. New wording: 'Two-pass validation is intentional', explicit causal note that the inner None=>continue is unreachable BECAUSE this pre-check ran, citation of workspace JMAP-wlip.1 silent-drop rule. cargo fmt + clippy + test green.
description: Each of task.rs:331-335, task_list.rs:231-234, task_notification.rs:120-123 inspects the destroy array up-front and returns invalidArguments if any element is not a JSON string. The alternative (silently skip non-string entries via the continue branch already in place) would let {destroy: [123, 'x']} attempt only 'x', leaving the client with no signal that '123' was dropped. A future contributor will be tempted to delete the up-front loop ('we already have the unreachable continue in the inner match'), missing the difference between 'unreachable because already validated' and 'silently skip'. The two-pass shape is intentional defensive depth.
title: Defend: non-string destroy element rejection across /set handlers
